description: This file implements functions related to handling HTTP response start line operations within an HTTP server framework. It includes functions for deleting, parsing, and copying start line information, and includes logic specific to managing HTTP response headers and start lines.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoRepDelStartLine(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up or deletes the start line information from the HTTP response object, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoRepParseStartLine(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Parses the start line of an HTTP response header from the raw header buffer, extracting and storing response info.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoRepCopyStartLineFrom(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,PULONG pulSize)
methods.description: Copies the start line of the HTTP response into an external buffer, suitable for transmission or display.

calls: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoRepCopyStartLineFrom(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject, PVOID buffer, PULONG pulSize)
